items.title: Polymarket: Fed Decision in September?
items.claim: Displayed 53% for a 25 bp increase and 47% for no change; the contract specifies upper-bound target-range change and an FOMC-statement resolution source.

items.title: Federal Reserve: FOMC meeting calendars
items.claim: Lists the September 15–16, 2026 FOMC meeting and marks it as associated with a Summary of Economic Projections.

items.title: BLS: September 2026 release schedule
items.claim: Schedules August PPI for September 10 at 08:30 ET and August CPI for September 11 at 08:30 ET.

items.title: Governor Waller: The Economic Outlook and Some Comments on My Policy Communication
items.claim: Waller said continued inflation progress would make him inclined to support holding, while hot August inflation could lead him to consider a hike.

items.title: CME: Understanding the FedWatch Tool Methodology
items.claim: CME describes FedWatch as an estimate derived from 30-Day Fed Funds futures prices under stated effective-rate and 25 bp increment assumptions.

items.title: Polymarket: Fed Decision in September?
items.claim: Displayed 55% for a 25 bp increase and 46% for no change; its named resolution is the upper-bound target-range change in the FOMC statement.

items.source_type: official Federal Reserve Beige Book summary
items.title: Federal Reserve: August 2026 Beige Book
items.claim: The national summary said activity increased modestly since early July and prices increased moderately; it was based on contacts collected on or before August 24.

items.title: CME FedWatch
items.claim: CME identifies FedWatch as probabilities implied by 30-Day Fed Funds futures; the live outcome grid remained inside an unreadable iframe in this check.
